title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (three-section presentation and signs)
key_points: The statement is titled "Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows" and is organized into exactly three sections: "Cash flows from operating activities", "Cash flows from investing activities", "Cash flows from financing activities".
Operating section starts from Net income $1,320 and adjusts for non-cash items and working-capital changes, ending at "Net cash provided by operating activities 3,565" (FY22).

Investing section lists Purchases of property and equipment (450), Purchases of short-term investments (2,667), Proceeds from maturity of short-term investments 4,310, Cash received from acquisition of Xilinx 2,366, Acquisition of Pensando net of cash acquired (1,544), Other (16); subtotal "Net cash provided by (used in) investing activities 1,999".

Financing section lists Proceeds from debt net of issuance costs 991, Repayment of debt (312), Proceeds from sales of common stock through employee equity plans 167, Repurchases of common stock (3,702), Common stock repurchases for tax withholding on employee equity plans (406), Other (2); subtotal "Net cash (used in) provided by financing activities (3,264)".
Sign convention as applied by AMD: cash outflows are shown in parentheses, inflows unparenthesized, and each subtotal is labeled "provided by (used in)".
The three subtotals roll into "Net increase in cash and cash equivalents 2,300", reconciled to beginning cash 2,535 and ending cash $4,835.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Supplemental cash flow information / non-cash investing and financing activities
key_points: The statement carries a "Supplemental cash flow information" block separate from the three main sections.

A distinct line group "Non-cash investing and financing activities" is disclosed outside the body of the statement, including: Purchases of property and equipment, accrued but not paid $157; Issuance of common stock to settle convertible debt $—; Issuance of common stock and treasury stock for the acquisition of Xilinx $48,514; Fair value of replacement share-based awards related to acquisition of Xilinx $275; Transfer of assets for the acquisition of property and equipment $13.
Non-cash lease activity is disclosed separately: Operating lease right-of-use assets acquired by assuming related liabilities $115.
Cash amounts paid are disclosed supplementally: interest $85 and income taxes net of refunds $685.
This demonstrates that material non-cash investing/financing transactions are excluded from the three-section body and reported as supplemental disclosure.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 2 Basis of Presentation and Significant Accounting Policies
key_points: Note 2 states the consolidated financial statements are prepared "in conformity with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (U.S. GAAP)".
The note describes the fiscal year as a 52- or 53-week year ending on the last Saturday in December; FY2022 ended December 31, 2022 and consisted of 53 weeks (FY2021 and FY2020 each 52 weeks).
Note 2 does NOT cite "ASC 230", "FASB", or "Regulation S-X", and contains no definitional language for the operating/investing/financing categories.
Note 2 also covers principles of consolidation (all inter-company accounts and transactions eliminated) and reclassification of prior-period amounts.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm (unqualified U.S. GAAP opinion)
key_points: The independent auditor (PCAOB ID: 42) audited the consolidated statements of operations, comprehensive income, stockholders' equity and cash flows for each of the three years ended December 31, 2022.

The opinion states the statements "present fairly, in all material respects, the financial position … and the results of its operations and its cash flows … in conformity with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles".
The audit report is dated February 27, 2023 and the ICFR opinion is unqualified.
This establishes that the three-category cash flow presentation in the filing was audited as U.S. GAAP-compliant, but the report does not name ASC 230 or Regulation S-X.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A: Operating Activities (quantified drivers)
key_points: FY22 operating cash flow of $3.6B is described as net income of $1.3B adjusted for non-cash adjustments of $4.1B and net cash outflows of $1.8B from changes in operating assets and liabilities.
Largest working-capital outflow driver: $1.4B increase in inventories, attributed to build of advanced process nodes to support the ramp of new products.
$1.1B increase in accounts receivable attributed to higher Q4 2022 revenue versus Q4 2021.
$1.2B increase in prepaid expenses and other assets attributed primarily to prepayments under long-term supply agreements in 2022.
Partially offsetting inflows: $931M increase in accounts payable (timing of payments to suppliers) and $546M increase in accrued liabilities and other (higher customer-related accruals).
FY21 comparison: operating cash flow $3.5B from net income of $3.2B, non-cash adjustments of $1.1B, and net cash outflows of $774M from operating assets and liabilities.
raw_excerpt: Net cash provided by operating activities was $3.6 billion in 2022, primarily due to our net income of $1.3 billion in 2022, adjusted for non-cash adjustments of $4.1 billion and net cash outflows of $1.8 billion from changes in our operating assets and liabilities. The primary drivers … included a $1.4 billion increase in inventories driven primarily by build of advanced process nodes to support the ramp of new products, a $1.1 billion increase in accounts receivable … and a $1.2 billion increase in prepaid expenses and other assets due primarily to prepayments under long-term supply agreements in 2022, offset by an $931 million increase in accounts payable … and a $546 million increase in accrued liabilities and other driven mainly by higher customer-related accruals.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Liquidity and Capital Resources (debt composition, Xilinx Notes)
key_points: Aggregate principal debt obligations were $2.5B at December 31, 2022, consisting primarily of $1.5B of Xilinx Notes assumed in the Xilinx acquisition and $1.0B of 3.924% Notes and 4.393% Notes issued during the year, versus $313M at December 25, 2021.
AMD repaid $312M of its 7.50% Senior Notes that matured in August 2022.

Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments were $5.9B at December 31, 2022 versus $3.6B at December 25, 2021; the increase was attributed to $2.4B cash and $1.6B short-term investments acquired from Xilinx, $1.0B from the 3.924%/4.393% Notes issuance, and cash flows from operations, partially offset by stock repurchases and cash paid for the Pensando acquisition.

A $3.0B five-year unsecured revolving credit facility was entered into on April 29, 2022 with no funds drawn during FY22; a $3.0B commercial paper program was established November 3, 2022 with no commercial paper outstanding at year end.
Unconditional purchase commitments were approximately $8.6B at December 31, 2022, of which $6.5B fall in fiscal 2023.
